agentMessages.content: Build a customer-support workflow for an online electronics shop. It should classify each request, answer product and delivery questions, look up order information only when the customer supplies an order ID, escalate refunds above EUR 100 or uncertain policy cases to a human, never invent an order status, and return a concise customer-facing reply plus an internal action summary.

agentSelectedToolConfig.customToolDesc: Classify the customer's message into a support category so the workflow can route it correctly. This is an internal decision-support step and does not change any external records.
Retrieve product facts, specifications, availability guidance, or compatibility details from the shop's product knowledge source. Use this to answer product questions without guessing.
Retrieve delivery, shipping, tracking, and fulfillment policy facts from the shop's delivery knowledge source. Use this to answer delivery questions without inventing details.
Look up order status, shipment, payment, or fulfillment details only when the customer supplies an order ID. Never use this tool without an order ID.
Create a human handoff for refund requests above EUR 100 or any case where policy interpretation is uncertain. Include context so a human agent can continue the case.
